question: In which of the following years was the Buddhist Chanting of Ladakh included in the UNESCO's list of intangible cultural heritage ?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2012**__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Buddhist chanting of Ladhak is a form of** musical verse**
 
• It is **2012** it was included in the representative list of** Humanity's intangible cultural Heritage**
 
• The Buddhist chanting of Ladakh refers to the recitation of sacred Buddhist texts in the state of **Jammu and Kashmir's trans-Himalayan** Ladakh region
 
• The chanting is a highly **orchestral drama.**
 
• The chanting meant for** peace and prosperity** of a large of the world​​
